title: Arthropod Pest Biology, Identification & IPM
description: Pest-specific specialist module covering identification evidence, cannabis aphid, spider and hemp russet mites, thrips, fungus gnats, movement pathways, containment and decision boundaries.
learningOutcomes: Differentiate major arthropod pest groups using body form, life stage, plant location, feeding evidence, by-products, movement, and appropriate magnification before assigning pest identity.
Compare cannabis aphid, twospotted spider mite, and hemp russet mite biology, injury patterns, detection limits, and confirmation needs without inventing unsupported action thresholds.
Distinguish thrips and fungus-gnat life stages, signs, injury patterns, sampling locations, and common look-alikes using evidence appropriate to greenhouse crop scouting.
Map likely arthropod movement pathways through plant material, people, tools, air movement, growing media, and crop zones and apply authorized containment and sanitation controls.

Document pest-identification confidence, specimen or image evidence, affected scope, unresolved look-alikes, monitoring method, and treatment-authority boundaries in a reconstructable plant-health record.
